results.title: PBAT Door-to-Door Movement lauds Yari, vows support for 2027 victory
results.description: THE PBAT Door-to-Door Movement 2027 has congratulated Senator Abdulaziz Yari Abubakar on his appointment as the Director-General of the Presidential Campaign Council for President Bola Tinubu The post PBAT Door-to-Door Movement lauds Yari, vows support for 2027 victory appeared first on Tribune Online .
